rules.name: library-independence
rules.reason: The installed library cannot depend on repository tooling, test suites, or serving frameworks.

rules.name: operation-semantics
rules.reason: Operation descriptions and validation remain usable with the Python standard library alone.

rules.name: tuning-data
rules.reason: Immutable tuning data cannot import runtime engines or execute offline searches.

rules.name: tuning-command
rules.reason: The tuning CLI selects lazy search commands; it does not embed a GPU implementation.

rules.name: runtime-inversion
rules.reason: Runtime orchestration uses operation models and provider ports; concrete providers are assembled only in composition.py.

rules.name: backend-direction
rules.reason: Backend adapters implement provider ports without calling the runtime controller or another application.

rules.name: build-independence
rules.reason: Wheel construction cannot require repository CI, benchmarks, test suites, or serving frameworks.

rules.name: build-planning
rules.reason: Build plans describe work without importing compilers, setuptools, Torch, or runtime kernels.

rules.name: common-dependencies
rules.reason: Shared CI primitives stay independent of the applications that use them.

rules.name: control-separation
rules.reason: Host controllers coordinate isolated executors; importing candidate GPU or framework code would cross that boundary.

rules.name: backend-compatibility-facade
rules.reason: Only the legacy package facade may forward available_backends to the canonical composition root.

rules.name: jit-orchestration
rules.reason: The JIT service coordinates injected recipe/compiler/module ports without importing concrete adapters or GPU packages.

rules.name: runtime-configuration
rules.reason: Built-in provider definitions are immutable metadata and do not import their implementations.

rules.name: build-orchestration
rules.reason: The build controller executes a plan through phase ports; packaging and compiler adapters are assembled outside it.

rules.name: kernel-resource-management
rules.reason: Precompiled kernel admission manages declared bytes and cache storage without importing GPU runtimes, compilers, CI or consumers.

rules.name: kernel-catalog
rules.reason: Kernel identity and selection metadata are usable independently of admission, compilers and hardware.
